subject.title: improve(ui): unify the New session draft with the start-screen layout

question: Should New Session use the final centered launcher-style composer in this PR, or preserve the linked issue’s requested bottom-docked composer?
rationale: Both implementations can be technically sound, but the final branch intentionally changed the core interaction layout after the canonical issue specified a bottom dock; code review cannot choose that product behavior safely.

options.title: Approve centered launcher
options.body: Keep the current branch layout and update the canonical issue or PR context so the accepted product direction is explicit.

options.title: Restore bottom dock
options.body: Revise the branch to match the linked issue’s pinned-bottom composer and retain the shared welcome consolidation where compatible.

recommendation.title: Approve centered launcher
recommendation.body: Keep the current branch layout and update the canonical issue or PR context so the accepted product direction is explicit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the recent chat-first/New Session direction on main and authored both the linked request and the final centered-layout revision.
